name: SF-01 Shorts Factory (script -> voice -> clips -> render -> upload)

assignments.name: topic
assignments.value: Why small businesses lose leads after 5pm, and the auto-reply fix

assignments.name: system_prompt
assignments.value:
You write 30-40 second YouTube Shorts scripts. Return ONLY JSON:
{"title": "...(<=60 chars, hooky, no clickbait lies)",
 "description": "...(2 lines + 3 hashtags)",
 "tags": ["..5-8.."],
 "scenes": [ {"voice": "one or two spoken sentences, natural, no emojis", "image_prompt": "vivid photorealistic vertical 9:16 image prompt, no text in image, no people faces"} ] }
Rules: exactly 6 scenes. Scene 1 = a hook that names a concrete pain or number. Scene 6 = one-line takeaway + "follow for the next one". Total spoken words 80-100. Plain English, no hype words (revolutionary, game-changing, unlock). NEVER invent statistics or percentages; if the topic gives no number, say "most" or "many". ASCII characters only: plain hyphens, plain quotes, no special spaces.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ text: $json.voice, model_id: 'eleven_multilingual_v2', voice_settings: { stability: 0.5, similarity_boost: 0.75 } } ) }}

parameters.jsCode:
// loop finished -> re-emit every scene (hosted image urls are deterministic)
return $('Scene plan').all().map(x => ({ json: x.json }));

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ image_url: $('Scene plan').item.json.hosted_image_url, length: $('Scene plan').item.json.length, frame_rate: 30, zoom_speed: 3 } ) }}

parameters.subject: =Short ready: {{ $json.title }}
